title: Manchester United v Brentford: Wobbling Hosts Meet the In-Form Visitors
body:
Manchester United host Brentford in the Premier League on 2026-11-28 [F1]. The home side have no wins from their last five league matches, with two points from two draws and three defeats [ST1].

The wider story is whether that slide is becoming a pattern. BBC Sport has asked whether Manchester United are this season's Tottenham, a reference to Spurs escaping relegation on the final day last season [S1]. The last meeting went Manchester United's way, 2-1 on 2026-04-27 [ST3].

They have two wins, a draw and two defeats from their last five league games, with seven points, eight goals scored and five conceded [ST2]. Set against Manchester United's record over the same spell [ST1], that is the stronger form on paper. Our model gives Brentford a 49% chance, Manchester United 31% and a draw 19% [M1].

Form matters, but big games have a habit of ignoring the spreadsheet. This is the kind of fixture where one moment of quality settles everything. A side on a poor run can find that moment in a flash of brilliance, or lose it to one defensive mix-up. Expect nerves, a tight opening and a finish nobody saw coming.

The Touchline Take: back the away side on the numbers [M1], but do not be shocked if this gets messy.
